name: browser_input
description: Click, type or press a key in the private server browser, scroll it with the wheel, pinch or hover, or save the site's sign-in.

repeat_guard.hint: read the page again to see whether the earlier click or typing already took effect; every input needs its own fresh read, so input cannot repeat blindly

selector.description: The target; it must lie inside the region your last browser_read read covered. press: optional, defaults to the focused element; touch, wheel, pinch and hover: required, the element whose centre is touched, scrolled over, pinched or hovered

text.description: type only: literal text to type; for passwords and codes use vault instead

vault.description: type only: the name of the user's vault entry to type, instead of text. Only into a sign-in field (user name, email, password or one-time code) on the entry's own https site; you never see the value

totp.description: type with vault only: the entry is an authenticator secret; type its current 6-digit code

key.description: press only: sent to selector, or to the focused element

dx.description: touch, wheel or pinch only: touch drags this many pixels horizontally after touching (negative is left); wheel scrolls this far horizontally (negative is left); pinch is how far each of the two fingers travels outward (positive spreads and zooms in). Omit dx and dy for a tap

dy.description: touch, wheel or pinch only: vertical travel in pixels (negative is up or scroll up)

origin.description: save_login only: the https origin of the site the browser is signed in to, for example https://example.com

action.description: a browser_read action (navigate, read, wait_for, scroll, ...) or click, type, press, touch, wheel, pinch, hover

timeout_ms.description: wait_for only: give up after this long (default 5000)

quiet_ms.description: wait_for quiet/network_idle: how long it must stay still (default 500)

dx.description: scroll, touch, wheel or pinch: horizontal pixels

dy.description: scroll, touch, wheel or pinch: vertical pixels

offset.description: read: character offset; measure: element offset. Use next_offset from the previous result

points.description: pixels only: viewport points in CSS px

steps.description: script only: up to 20 steps run in order in one call and approved once. Each step is an object with a browser_read action (navigate, read, wait_for, viewport, screenshot, ...) or click/type/press/touch/wheel/pinch/hover and their fields. Add "screenshot": true to a step to get an image after it; no other step returns one. A failed step stops the script and returns a screenshot of that moment. A step's "label" names its screenshot in the chat.

examples: click a button on the page
